question: What is total revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: Show completed revenue
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS completed_revenue FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: How many orders are there, including every status?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders

question: How many completed orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: What is average order value?
sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_order_value FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: How many registered customers?
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS customers FROM customers

question: Revenue by product
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name

question: Revenue by category
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: Revenue by country
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers u ON u.id=o.customer_id JOIN countries c ON c.id=u.country_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: Revenue by region
sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers u ON u.id=o.customer_id JOIN countries c ON c.id=u.country_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.region

question: Monthly revenue for 2025
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',order_date)::date AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Total revenue during 2025
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Completed revenue from Germany
sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers u ON u.id=o.customer_id JOIN countries c ON c.id=u.country_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.name='Germany'

question: How many cancelled orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

question: Which products sold the most units on completed orders?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY quantity DESC
